# Al Rauf International Quran Academy

> Al Rauf International Quran Academy offers 1-on-1 online Quran classes taught by qualified, Ijazah-certified Pakistani teachers, serving students and families worldwide including the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, and the Gulf region. Founded by Hafiz Abdul Rauf.

## Courses
- [Noorani Qaida](https://alraufquranacademy.com/#courses): Foundational Arabic letter recognition for beginners
- [Quran Reading](https://alraufquranacademy.com/#courses): Fluent Quran recitation training
- [Tajweed](https://alraufquranacademy.com/#courses): Correct pronunciation and recitation rules
- [Hifz](https://alraufquranacademy.com/#courses): Quran memorization program
- [Islamic Studies](https://alraufquranacademy.com/#courses): Included free with any course

## Key Information
- [Pricing](https://alraufquranacademy.com/pricing): Starting at $3/class, transparent per-class and monthly rates
- [Free Trial](https://alraufquranacademy.com/book-trial): 3 free trial classes, no payment required
- [About](https://alraufquranacademy.com/about): Founder story and mission
- [Why Choose Us](https://alraufquranacademy.com/why-choose-us): Objective evaluation guide, quick facts, and academy comparison
- [FAQ](https://alraufquranacademy.com/faq): Common questions about online Quran classes
- [Teachers](https://alraufquranacademy.com/teachers): Qualified, Ijazah-certified tutors, female tutors available
- [Contact](https://alraufquranacademy.com/contact): Direct contact and support via WhatsApp and email
